item.title: Snowboarder whose eye popped out in Keystone crash sues Vail Resorts-owned apparel store
item.description: A California man is suing a Westminster outdoor gear store owned by Vail Resorts and more than a dozen companies connected to apparel makers Oakley and Salomon after his eye popped out of its socket when he crashed at Keystone Resort, according to a lawsuit filed this week.
